newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June S&P 500 futures finish sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June S&P 500 futures finish sharply higher.

text.p: U.S. June Standard and Poor's 500 futures finished sharply higher and near the day's high after a swift bounce from midafternoon session lows.
"Once the bond market closed we got a pretty snappy comeback and they rebounded pretty nicely," one S&P 500 futures trader said.

June had started the day sharply higher, up the seven-point opening limit amid Treasury bond market strength after benign inflation news. The core March consumer price index rose 0.2 percent and the overall index rose 0.1 percent, below forecasts, setting the tone for the rest of the session.
Traders said hedge fund short-covering and technicals fueled the afternoon run to new daily highs.
"It was a pretty steady rally," another S&P 500 futures trader said. "I think we're going at least to 761.50 and see if we can roll on from there," he said.
Traders noted that 761.50 is the top of a gap left over from day session action Thursday and Friday. Today's day session open leaves a gap from 748.20 to 749.50.
"Overall I still think you sell rallies," he said, adding that the market was not as nervous as it had been in recent weeks and today's action appeared orderly.
Another trader agreed that S&Ps appeared to be mounting a campaign for 761.50.
"Bigger picture, there's a shoulder at 774.60 -- last week's high," he said. "That is where our fortunes lie. If we can hold that area they'll come off again," he said.
Traders said technology sector weakness and talk of asset allocation out of stocks into bonds hampered the bullish momentum at midday.
Once T-bond futures closed, June S&P 500s were able to recover from their lows.

At the close, June S&P 500s were up 12.40 points at 759.70, Nasdaq 100s lost 8.85 points to 807.00, Russell 2000s were up 2.30 points at 343.65, KCBT Value Line futures rallied 6.95 points to 688.35, Nikkei 225 index futures rose 340.0 to 18,080.0 and Midcap 400s gained 1.40 points to 253.50.
